articles.title: 俄羅斯莫斯科餐廳爆炸3死21傷　當局稱是自製炸彈襲擊
articles.summary: 俄羅斯莫斯科一間餐廳爆炸，死咗3個人，21個人受傷。

levels.text: 俄羅斯莫斯科市中心有一間餐廳爆炸，死咗3個人，仲有21個人受傷。當地話，呢次爆炸係有人自己整嘅炸彈搞出嚟。爆炸喺當地時間星期六晚發生，有個女人想帶住個炸彈入餐廳，畀餐廳保安攔住，跟住炸彈爆咗，個女人同保安即場死咗，仲有一個客人都死埋。
levels.text_en: A restaurant in central Moscow, Russia, exploded, killing 3 people and injuring 21. Local authorities say the explosion was caused by a bomb someone made themselves. The explosion happened on Saturday night local time. A woman tried to bring a bomb into the restaurant, but was stopped by restaurant security, then the bomb went off. The woman and the security guard died on the spot, and a customer also died.

levels.text: 俄羅斯國家反恐委員會話，莫斯科市中心一間餐廳發生嘅爆炸，係由自己整嘅炸彈引起，事件死咗3個人，有21個人受傷。爆炸喺當地時間星期六晚發生。報道話，有一名女子想帶住自製炸彈闖入餐廳，畀餐廳保安攔住，之後炸彈爆咗，個女子同保安當場死咗，事件仲有一名顧客死亡。發生爆炸嘅餐廳，位於俄羅斯一座著名地標建築庫德林廣場大樓。
levels.text_en: Russia's National Anti-Terrorism Committee said the explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow was caused by a homemade bomb; the incident killed 3 people and injured 21. The explosion happened on Saturday night local time. Reports say a woman tried to enter the restaurant carrying a homemade bomb but was stopped by restaurant security, after which the bomb went off. The woman and the security guard died on the spot, and a customer also died. The restaurant where the explosion occurred is located in a famous Russian landmark building, the Kudrinskaya Square building.

levels.text: 俄羅斯國家反恐委員會表示，莫斯科市中心一間餐廳發生嘅爆炸，係由自製炸彈裝置引起，事件造成3人死亡、21人受傷。爆炸喺當地時間星期六晚發生。報道話，一名女子企圖攜帶自製炸彈裝置闖入餐廳，畀餐廳保安阻攔，隨後裝置啟動爆炸，該名女子同保安當場死亡，事件仲造成一名顧客死亡。據了解，發生爆炸嘅餐廳位於俄羅斯著名地標建築庫德林廣場大樓。
levels.text_en: Russia's National Anti-Terrorism Committee stated that the explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow was caused by a homemade explosive device; the incident resulted in 3 deaths and 21 injuries. The explosion happened on Saturday night local time. Reports say a woman attempted to force her way into the restaurant carrying a homemade explosive device but was blocked by restaurant security, after which the device detonated. The woman and the security guard died on the spot, and the incident also caused the death of a customer. It is understood the restaurant where the explosion occurred is located in a famous Russian landmark building, the Kudrinskaya Square building.

levels.text: 俄羅斯國家反恐委員會說，莫斯科市中心一間餐廳發生爆炸。這次爆炸由自製炸彈引起，造成3人死亡、21人受傷。爆炸在當地時間星期六晚上發生。報道說，一名女子想帶自製炸彈進入餐廳，被保安攔住，之後炸彈爆炸。該女子和保安當場死亡，還有一名顧客死亡。這間餐廳位於俄羅斯著名地標建築庫德林廣場大樓。
levels.text_en: Russia's National Anti-Terrorism Committee said an explosion occurred at a restaurant in central Moscow. This explosion was caused by a homemade bomb, resulting in 3 deaths and 21 injuries. The explosion happened on Saturday night local time. Reports say a woman wanted to bring a homemade bomb into the restaurant but was stopped by security, after which the bomb exploded. The woman and the security guard died on the spot, and a customer also died. This restaurant is located in a famous Russian landmark building, the Kudrinskaya Square building.

levels.text: 俄羅斯國家反恐委員會表示，莫斯科市中心一間餐廳發生的爆炸是由自製爆炸裝置引起，事件造成3人死亡、21人受傷。 爆炸在當地時間星期六晚發生，報道說，一名女子企圖攜帶自製爆炸裝置闖入餐廳，被餐廳保安阻攔，隨後爆炸裝置啟動，該名女子和保安當場死亡。事故還造成一名顧客死亡。 據了解，發生爆炸的餐廳位於俄羅斯著名地標建築庫德林廣場大樓。 編輯︰張萬燕
levels.text_en: Russia's National Anti-Terrorism Committee stated that the explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow was caused by a homemade explosive device; the incident resulted in 3 deaths and 21 injuries. The explosion happened on Saturday night local time. Reports say a woman attempted to force her way into the restaurant carrying a homemade explosive device but was blocked by restaurant security, after which the explosive device detonated, and the woman and the security guard died on the spot. The accident also caused the death of a customer. It is understood the restaurant where the explosion occurred is located in a famous Russian landmark building, the Kudrinskaya Square building. Editor: Cheung Man-yin

articles.summary_en: A bombing at a restaurant in central Moscow, Russia, killed 3 people and injured 21. Russian authorities say it was caused by a homemade bomb.

articles.title: 國米互射十二碼贏曼城　現場觀賞球星獻技球迷感興奮
articles.summary: 喺啟德體育園嘅足球盛會，國際米蘭互射十二碼贏咗曼城，好多球迷都好興奮。

levels.text: 喺啟德體育園有個足球盛會，國際米蘭同曼城比賽。踢完九十分鐘打成一比一，最後互射十二碼，國米三比一贏咗曼城。有超過四萬二千個球迷入場睇波。好多球迷都話現場氣氛好好，比賽好刺激，可以喺香港睇到自己支持嘅球星踢波，真係好難得，佢哋都好興奮。
levels.text_en: There was a football event at Kai Tak Sports Park, a match between Inter Milan and Manchester City. After 90 minutes it was tied 1-1, and in the end they took penalties, with Inter beating Man City 3-1. Over 42,000 fans came to watch. Many fans said the atmosphere was great and the match was exciting; being able to see the stars they support play in Hong Kong is really rare, and they were very excited.

levels.text: 喺啟德體育園舉行嘅「香港足球盛會」，意甲班霸國際米蘭互射十二碼三比一贏咗英超勁旅曼城。呢場比賽吸引超過四萬二千名球迷入場，仲有幾位官員現場觀戰。好多球迷都話現場氣氛好好，比賽好刺激，可以喺香港睇到支持嘅球星踢波真係好難得，佢哋都好興奮。兩隊喺呢場季前熱身賽都派咗好多球星正選上陣。開賽後雙方互有攻守，曼城先入一球，但幾分鐘後國米就追平，半場一比一。最後九十分鐘都分唔出勝負，要互射十二碼決勝。
levels.text_en: At the 'Hong Kong Football Festival' held at Kai Tak Sports Park, Serie A champions Inter Milan beat English Premier League powerhouse Manchester City 3-1 on penalties. The match drew over 42,000 fans, and several officials watched in person. Many fans said the atmosphere was great and the match was exciting; being able to see the stars they support play in Hong Kong is really rare, and they were very excited. Both teams fielded many stars in the starting lineups for this pre-season warm-up. After kickoff both sides attacked and defended; Man City scored first, but a few minutes later Inter equalized, 1-1 at halftime. After 90 minutes there was still no winner, so it was decided by penalties.

levels.text: 喺啟德體育園舉行嘅「香港足球盛會」，意甲班霸國際米蘭互射十二碼三比一擊敗英超勁旅曼城。呢場賽事吸引超過四萬二千名球迷入場，財政司副司長黃偉綸、商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺、文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩等官員都有現場觀戰。唔少球迷都話現場氣氛好好，比賽相當刺激，能夠喺香港睇到支持嘅球星獻技非常難得，感到好興奮。兩隊喺呢場季前熱身賽都派出多名球星正選上陣。開賽後雙方快打快，互有攻守，曼城先由梅巴馬開紀錄，但國米好快憑柏華特追平，半場一比一。換邊後曼城積極搶攻，但多次機會都入唔到波，九十分鐘未能分出勝負，要互射十二碼決勝。
levels.text_en: At the 'Hong Kong Football Festival' held at Kai Tak Sports Park, Serie A champions Inter Milan beat English Premier League powerhouse Manchester City 3-1 on penalties. The match drew over 42,000 fans, and officials including Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau, and Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law watched in person. Many fans said the atmosphere was great and the match was quite exciting; being able to see the stars they support show their skills in Hong Kong is very rare, and they felt very excited. Both teams fielded many stars in the starting lineups for this pre-season warm-up. After kickoff both sides played fast and had attacks and defenses; Man City opened the scoring through Mbappe... [player], but Inter quickly equalized through B華特, 1-1 at halftime. After changing ends Man City attacked aggressively, but couldn't convert their many chances; after 90 minutes there was no winner, so it was decided by penalties.

levels.text: 在啟德體育園舉行的「香港足球盛會」，國際米蘭互射十二碼以三比一擊敗曼城。這場比賽吸引超過四萬二千名球迷入場。財政司副司長黃偉綸、商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺、文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩等官員也到場觀看。不少球迷說現場氣氛很好，比賽很刺激。能在香港看到支持的球星演出，十分難得，令他們很興奮。這是一場季前熱身賽，兩隊都派出多名球星正選上陣。開賽後雙方互有攻守。曼城先由梅巴馬入球，但國米很快憑柏華特追平，半場一比一。換邊後曼城積極搶攻，可惜多次機會都沒有入球。九十分鐘後未能分出勝負，最後要互射十二碼決勝。
levels.text_en: At the 'Hong Kong Football Festival' held at Kai Tak Sports Park, Inter Milan beat Manchester City 3-1 on penalties. This match drew over 42,000 fans. Officials including Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau, and Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law also attended to watch. Many fans said the atmosphere was very good and the match was exciting. Being able to see the stars they support perform in Hong Kong is very rare, making them very excited. This was a pre-season warm-up, and both teams fielded many stars in the starting lineups. After kickoff both sides attacked and defended. Man City scored first through their player, but Inter quickly equalized, 1-1 at halftime. After changing ends Man City attacked aggressively, but unfortunately failed to score from their many chances. After 90 minutes there was no winner, and in the end it was decided by penalties.

levels.text: 在啟德體育園舉行的「香港足球盛會」，意甲班霸國際米蘭互射十二碼3:1擊敗英超勁旅曼城。 賽事吸引超過4萬2千名球迷入場，財政司副司長黃偉綸、商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺、文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩等官員都有現場觀戰。 不少球迷都表示，現場氣氛很好，比賽相當刺激，能夠看到支持的球星在香港獻技是非常難得的事，感到非常興奮。 兩隊在這場季前熱身賽都派出多名球星正選上陣，包括曼城的科頓、施曼尤、當拿隆馬，以及國米的巴列拿、迪馬高等。 雙方開賽「快打快」、互有攻守。曼城由梅巴馬先開紀錄，但幾分鐘後國米就憑柏華特追平，半場踢成1:1。 換邊後，曼城壓著國米積極搶攻，但多次機會無法化成入球，雙方在法定時間90分鐘未能分出勝負。 曼城在新任領隊馬列斯卡首場執教的賽事，互射十二碼首3輪都宴客，最終1:3 不敵國米。
levels.text_en: At the 'Hong Kong Football Festival' held at Kai Tak Sports Park, Serie A champions Inter Milan beat English Premier League powerhouse Manchester City 3:1 on penalties. The event drew over 42,000 fans, and officials including Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau, and Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law watched in person. Many fans said the atmosphere was very good and the match was quite exciting; being able to see the stars they support show their skills in Hong Kong is a very rare thing, and they felt very excited. Both teams fielded many stars in the starting lineups for this pre-season warm-up, including Man City's Kovacic, Savinho, and Donnarumma, and Inter's Barella and De Marco... [players]. Both sides played fast at kickoff and had attacks and defenses. Man City opened the scoring first, but a few minutes later Inter equalized through their player, tied 1:1 at halftime. After changing ends, Man City pressed Inter and attacked aggressively, but couldn't convert their many chances into goals; the two sides had no winner in the regular 90 minutes. In new manager Maresca's first game in charge, Man City missed all of their first three penalties and ultimately lost 1:3 to Inter.

articles.summary_en: A pre-season friendly football match (part of the 'Hong Kong Football Festival') held at Kai Tak Sports Park, where Italian club Inter Milan beat English club Manchester City on penalties.
